_comment: Where the raw datasets live. The resolver in src/data/paths.py auto-discovers the real class-folder root under each of these bases by matching folder names against the taxonomy signature, so it does not matter if Kaggle nests an extra 'color/color' level or similar -- verified against the abdallahalidev/plantvillage-dataset and abdulhasibuddin/plant-doc-dataset Kaggle mirrors.

local_search_roots._comment: Extra bases searched in addition to kaggle_input_dir, so the exact same code also runs outside Kaggle (this repo's local data/ folder, a laptop, etc). Safe to leave pointing at paths that don't exist -- they are just skipped.

_variants_note: Only 'color' (true RGB photos) is used for this project. grayscale/segmented are pre-processed derivatives of the same underlying photos and are excluded to avoid leaking pre-segmented masks into an RGB pipeline.
